title: Parse a port number
hints: `'7' - '0'` is `7`. Building a number from digits left to right is `value = value * 10 + digit`, just like reading it aloud.

Reject an empty string up front, and return false the moment you see a non-digit (`isdigit`). Check `value > 65535` **inside** the loop, after each digit, so a huge input can't overflow and wrap around before you notice.
`unsigned long v = 0; for (...) { if (!isdigit(c)) return false; v = v * 10 + (unsigned long)(c - '0'); if (v > 65535) return false; } *out = (unsigned)v; return true;`
